summary: Plafond hint in invoice editor tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest test_iteration53_plafond_hint.py (8/8 pass) covers GET /api/intenti escludi param (draft own usage excluded, unknown id no effect, list without party unchanged), PUT draft up to full plafond OK / +0.01 -> 422 'Plafond superato', new invoice over residuo 422, TD04 credit note increases residuo. Iteration52 regression suite 26/26 pass. Frontend (Playwright, TEST_T53UI fixture): new invoice for N3.5 client shows plafond-hint green (Residuo 5000 -> dopo 4000), amber + plafond-hint-basso at dopo 500 (<=10%), red + plafond-hint-superato at qty 2x4500; live updates on qty/price change; Salva shows 422 toast 'Plafond superato...' and stays on /fatture/nuova. No hint for normal client (C) nor when aliquota changed to 22; plafond-hint-none for N3.5 client without declaration and when date moved to previous year. Edit draft calls /api/intenti?party_id=..&escludi=<id> and shows Residuo 8000 (own 3000 excluded) -> correct live values, save OK. Credit note (?da=sent) shows 'dopo questa nota' with residuo increased (2000 -> 4000). All TEST data cleaned up (admin sessions untouched).

issues: fmtEUR (Intl it-IT) does not group 4-digit amounts: hint shows 'Residuo 5000,00 €' next to 'plafond 10.000,00 €', while the backend toast shows '5.000,00 €'. Consider useGrouping:'always' (or minimumGroupingDigits:1) for consistency (app-wide cosmetic).
In amber state the progress bar (Barra) is red at ~5% while the box is amber - slight colour mismatch (cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: for TD04 PlafondHint should pick the same declaration as backend scegli() (original invoice's intento / max utilizzato) instead of the first with residuo >= imponibile; with multiple declarations the hint may show a different protocollo than the one the NC will be attached to.
Optional cosmetic: consistent thousands grouping in fmtEUR.
critical_code_review_comments: PlafondHint NC selection logic differs from backend scegli() for nc=True (backend prefers fattura_collegata's intento or max utilizzato) - only visible with >1 declaration per year.
PlafondHint fetches only when partyId/invoiceId/imponibile>0 change; date filtering is client-side so date changes are handled correctly (verified).
seed_data_creation: TEST_T53 / TEST_T53UI companies, parties, declarations, invoices and test sessions created via fixtures and fully deleted afterwards (verified 0 remaining).
